hypothesis: If C67's FACT consequence objectives are responsible for its action and LIBERO effect, then the matched C67-s20000 joint arm will outperform this action-only s20000 arm; otherwise the observed change is attributable to additional action-tower optimization rather than future-representation/state/value supervision.
single_variable: Relative to C67, C69 sets future-representation/state/value objective weights to zero and freezes only their six encoder/decoder modules. C58 parent, full 30-layer shared tower, online frozen INT8 H3, model initialization seed, joint-token forward topology, deterministic sample order, 4/2/1/1 rank categories, failure action masks, AdamW groups for every still-trainable parameter, learning rates, warmup, cosine horizon, 20000 optimizer steps and checkpoint cadence remain fixed.
parent_baseline: Both arms initialize from promoted C58B s10000 SHA256 2e6294712f7944037c3982ae7e6b8b87adbdaab190e1972ff4a3d592cc99e541. C67-s20000 is the sole matched joint-objective treatment; historical C60/C55/D0 results are context only.
